intent: A turnaround reference set needs one coherent rendering style and neutral, consistent lighting across every view so image-to-3D generation reads material and form consistently; the current mixed rendering breaks that.
subject: The market lamp prop, rendered consistently across its full reference set.
camera: Stable reference framing; lighting motivated by one neutral, even source across all views.
avoid: dramatic or directional lighting that shifts between views
half-rendered or inconsistent material response across the set
change: contradictory cool/warm lighting with no single source
